name: Insecurity
overview: Scripture reveals that insecurity is overcome by trusting in the Lord’s provision and care, as He is our Shepherd who ensures we lack nothing (Psalms 23:1). Believers find confidence in knowing they are fearfully and wonderfully made by God (Psalms 139:14) and that He has plans for peace and hope for their future (Jeremiah 29:11). True freedom from insecurity comes through knowing the truth of Christ (John 8:32), who came to give abundant life (John 10:10), and by allowing the renewing of the mind to discern God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2).
